facts.fact: MoffettNathanson's figures show 31% of homes pay for the traditional bundle, while 48% (61.5 million) pay when vMVPDs are included.
facts.quote: MoffettNathanson’s own figures show the gap: 31% of homes pay for the traditional bundle, but 48% (61.5 million) pay when vMVPDs are included.

facts.fact: Per Deadline, MoffettNathanson's Q3 2025 report did not size the total cord-cutting market, and industry estimates ranged from 65 million to 70 million.
facts.quote: Deadline noted that MoffettNathanson’s Q3 2025 report didn’t size the total market, and that industry estimates ranged from 65 million to 70 million.

facts.fact: According to Nielsen's Ad Supported Gauge, ad-supported TV was 71.5% of total viewing in Q2 2026.
facts.quote: In Q2 2026, ad-supported TV was 71.5% of total viewing, according to Nielsen’s Ad Supported Gauge

facts.fact: Among all viewers aged 2 and older, streaming held 48.2% of ad-supported TV in Q2 2026, per Nielsen.
facts.quote: Among all viewers aged 2 and older, streaming held 48.2% of ad-supported TV in Q2 2026.

facts.fact: For adults 18 and older, Nielsen put streaming at 44.4% of ad-supported TV viewing, broadcast at 28.6% and cable at 27.0%.
facts.quote: For adults 18 and older, Nielsen put streaming at 44.4%, with broadcast rising to 28.6% and cable to 27.0%.
